runner.final_answer:
The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what I built in `server.mjs`:

## `listTools()`
Returns two tools with strict JSON schemas (`additionalProperties: false` on each, with explicit `required` arrays):
- **`note_create`** — `title` and `body` (both required strings)
- **`note_get`** — `note_id` (required string)

## `callTool(name, args)`
- **`note_create`**: validates that `title` and `body` are non-empty strings, stores the note in an in-memory `Map`, and assigns a stable generated id of the form `n1`, `n2`, … (monotonic counter). Returns MCP-style structured text content `Created note nN: <title>`.
- **`note_get`**: validates `note_id`, looks up the note, and returns structured text content containing the title and body.
- **Validation/rejection**: throws on empty/missing required fields, unknown note ids, and unknown tool names (all caught by the protocol layer in `protocol.mjs` and turned into JSON-RPC errors).

## Test results
Both tests pass (`create then get` and `lists two tools`), and I verified additional edge cases (unknown tool, empty title, missing body, missing note) all reject correctly, with stable `n1`/`n2` ids across creates.
